title: QAgent managed policy
description: Enterprise policy for QAgent. Every key is optional. Without a managed policy there are no restrictions.

blockedUrlPatterns.description: URL patterns QAgent must never act on, e.g. "bank.example.com", "*.payments.example.com/*". Covers the host and its subdomains.

allowedUrlPatterns.description: When set, QAgent may only act on URLs matching one of these patterns.

allowedProviders.description: Provider ids or types allowed for model calls (e.g. "openai", "anthropic", "ollama"). When set, other providers are refused.
